proposal.summary: Eclipse Mosquitto versions 1.3.2 through 2.x before 2.0.16 has a memory leak that can be exploited remotely through QoS 2 messages with duplicate message IDs.
proposal.cwe_quote: The broker in Eclipse Mosquitto 1.3.2 through 2.x before 2.0.16 has a memory leak that can be abused remotely when a client sends many QoS 2 messages with duplicate message IDs, and fails to respond to PUBREC commands.

AV.quote: can be abused remotely when a client sends many QoS 2 messages with duplicate message IDs

A.quote: can cause a partial interruption to the availability of AMQ Broker via an Out of memory (OOM) condition.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Investigate and patch affected versions of Eclipse Mosquitto to prevent memory leak exploitation.

evidence_quotes.claim: Memory leak can be abused remotely
evidence_quotes.quote: can be abused remotely when a client sends many QoS 2 messages with duplicate message IDs
can cause a partial interruption to the availability of AMQ Broker via an Out of memory (OOM) condition.
